mapper.update: UPDATE target_item SET status = #{status}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ti.id, t.NAME, t.description, ti.STATUS, ti.create_time FROM target_item AS ti LEFT JOIN target AS t ON t.id = ti.target_id WHERE DATE ( ti.create_time ) = #{createTime} AND ti.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT #{offset} , #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into target_item (target_id, user_id, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{targetId}, #{userId}, #{status}, now(), now());

insert.foreach: INSERT INTO target_item (target_id, user_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{item.targetId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.status}, now())
